cities.description: A vibrant harbour city known for the Sydney Opera House and its golden beaches.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A cultural capital with street art, laneway cafes and beautiful gardens.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A bustling metropolis that mixes neon skylines with historic temples.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Famous for its classical temples, gardens and traditional tea houses.

cities.description: A huge city with world-class food, museums and nightlife.
